diagnoses.description: The OOXML unpack script pretty-prints XML using ASCII encoding (`toprettyxml(..., encoding="ascii")`). This can rewrite non-ASCII text into character references and changes the XML encoding declaration, reducing round-trip fidelity and risking unintended changes when the task requires keeping everything else unchanged.

locations.section: Pretty print all XML files (dom.toprettyxml(..., encoding="ascii"))

diagnoses.description: The PPTX skill documentation is generic about editing PPTX via OOXML, but provides no workflow guidance for the task’s core requirement: extracting/updating/re-embedding an embedded Excel worksheet/table (OLE object under `ppt/embeddings/*`) while preserving formulas and avoiding full-deck rewrites. This misalignment can lead to using inappropriate approaches (e.g., editing only slide XML or saving via python-pptx) that won’t update the embedded workbook correctly or may rewrite unrelated parts.

locations.section: Editing an existing PowerPoint presentation (OOXML unpack/edit/pack workflow) and overall Overview/Reading sections (no embedded Excel/OLE handling)

diagnoses.description: There is an internal validation inconsistency: `pack.py` supports validating `.xlsx` outputs via soffice conversion, but `validate.py` explicitly treats `.xlsx` as unsupported and exits with an error. This mismatch can confuse/impede validation workflows when editing an embedded workbook for this task.

locations.section: Validator selection match-case: default branch prints "Validation not supported" for .xlsx
